授業概要
This class is aimed at graduate students in scientific fields who wish to improve their oral and listening skills. This course will focus on developing fluency and building confidence to speak on academic topics. There will also be an emphasis on improving academic vocabulary and reinforcing presentation skills.

授業の進め方
To facilitate the objectives of the class, classroom activities will involve students engaging in tasks in small groups and doing presentations in front of their peers. Students will be asked to listen to and evaluate the information being presented by taking notes and asking questions. Each lesson will be done over a 2-week period.
